+    private fun findClosestSpecialPointByPixel(

+        touchXpx: Float,

+        tapRadiusScale: Float = 1.0f

+
+        val dataSets = chart.data?.dataSets ?: return null
+        val density = chart.context.resources.displayMetrics.density
+
+        for (dataSet in dataSets) {

+            if (lineDataSet.label.isNotEmpty() || lineDataSet.entryCount != 1) continue
+
+            val circleColor = lineDataSet.circleColors.firstOrNull() ?: continue
+            val pointType = when (circleColor) {
+                ContextCompat.getColor(chart.context, R.color.accent_green) -> PointTooltipMarker.PointType.SPEED_100
+                ContextCompat.getColor(chart.context, R.color.accent_blue) -> PointTooltipMarker.PointType.SPEED_200
+                ContextCompat.getColor(chart.context, R.color.accent_red) -> PointTooltipMarker.PointType.DISTANCE_402
+                else -> continue
+            }
+
+            val priority = when (pointType) {

+                PointTooltipMarker.PointType.SPEED_200 -> 2

+
+            val dx = touchXpx - pos.x
+            val dy = touchYpx - pos.y

+
+            val pointRadiusPx = lineDataSet.circleRadius * density * tapRadiusScale
+            if (distance <= pointRadiusPx) {
+                candidatePoints.add(

+                )
